result.instructions: Tools for TinyPNG, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many compressions have I used this month, and is my key valid?"; "Compress this product photo: https://example.com/images/shoe.jpg"; "Shrink the image at https://example.com/banner.png to 800 pixels wide.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TinyPNG data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tinypng_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tinypng_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tinypng_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. tinypng_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tinypng_compress_image
tools.title: Compress an image from a URL
tools.description: WRITE (uses quota): ask TinyPNG (Tinify) to fetch a public image by URL and compress it (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or JPEG XL). Returns the output_url (Tinify's Location address of the compressed image), the compressed size and type, the savings when the input size is known, and the Compression-Count header (compressions used this month). The image is stored by Tinify for about 48 hours; output_url needs your API key, so use tinypng_download_image to get the bytes and tinypng_transform_image to resize, convert or keep metadata. Each compression counts against the monthly quota of your Tinify API key (the free plan includes 500 per month); resizing and converting count one extra compression each. POST /shrink.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to compress. Tinify's servers fetch it, so it must be reachable from the internet.

annotations.title: Compress an image from a URL

tools.name: tinypng_transform_image
tools.title: Resize, convert or keep metadata of a compressed image
tools.description: WRITE (uses quota): apply a resize, a format conversion and/or metadata preservation to an image compressed earlier (the output_url from tinypng_compress_image, valid about 48 hours). Returns the resulting type, byte size, width, height and Compression-Count; the image itself is returned too when include_image is true and it is under 1 MB. Resize: method scale (give width OR height), or fit / cover / thumb (give width AND height); images are never scaled up. Convert: one or more of image/webp, image/jpeg, image/png, image/avif, image/jxl (several = the smallest is returned) or */* (the smallest of WebP, JPEG, PNG); converting a transparent image to JPEG needs a background colour. Preserve: copyright, creation, location (location is JPEG only) keeps that metadata, which makes the file slightly larger. Each call is a fresh request: resize and convert each count one extra compression on your monthly Tinify quota, preserve is free. Tinify returns the bytes only (no new URL), so only include_image gives you the transformed file, and only when it is under 1 MB. POST /output/{id}.

output_url.description: The output_url returned by tinypng_compress_image (https://api.tinify.com/output/<id>), or just the id. Outputs are kept by Tinify for about 48 hours.

resize_method.description: Resize method. scale: width or height; fit/cover/thumb: width and height.

convert_to.description: Target type(s), e.g. ["image/webp"]. Several = the smallest result is returned. ["*/*"] = the smallest of WebP, JPEG, PNG.

background.description: Background for transparent areas when converting to a type without transparency (JPEG): "#rrggbb", "white" or "black". Only with convert_to.

preserve.description: Metadata to keep: copyright, creation, location (JPEG only).

include_image.description: Also return the resulting image (only when it is under 1 MB). Default false: sizes only.

annotations.title: Resize, convert or keep metadata of a compressed image

tools.name: tinypng_download_image
tools.title: Download a compressed image
tools.description: Fetch the compressed image of an earlier tinypng_compress_image (its output_url, valid about 48 hours) and return it as an image with its type, byte size, width and height. Images over 1 MB are described but not returned inline. Downloading does not use extra compression quota. GET /output/{id}.

output_url.description: The output_url returned by tinypng_compress_image (https://api.tinify.com/output/<id>), or just the id. Outputs are kept by Tinify for about 48 hours.

tools.name: tinypng_get_usage
tools.title: Get compression usage this month
tools.description: How many compressions your Tinify API key has used this calendar month (the Compression-Count header), and whether the key is valid. The check sends an empty request that Tinify refuses, so nothing is compressed and no quota is used. Compare with your Tinify plan (the free plan includes 500 per month). POST /shrink with no body.
